en.title: Guillaume holds on, Hugo slips, Simon rules bingo
bullets: 🏒 Guillaume (Laser Kiwis) keeps the lead at 552 points, 11 clear of Sylvianne (Maman Girafe). Michel (Les Ducks) is next at 538.
McDavid and Draisaitl lit the lamp in Edmonton: 15 participants are smiling over McDavid, and Leon is one goal shy of 25.
